messages:
priya: Heads-up — we saw a spike in `compat_mismatch_count` after yesterday's v2 routing tweak. Need to decide how loud the console should make this for customers.

zack: saw that. rate is ~3% of requests for a handful of orgs. fallback to v1 is happening but metrics not surfaced well.

maria: do we have an event stream for the fallback reason? currently it's just `fallback=true` in logs. we should add `fallback_reason` (e.g. header, quota, model-mismatch).

ryan: +1 on reason. also want a sampling header so we can pull traces for affected requests: `X-RW-Debug-Sample: <id>`. low overhead.

priya: proposal: add `X-RW-Compat` header echoing chosen route and `X-RW-Fallback-Reason` when fallback happens. console will show aggregated counts and top reasons.

zack: agree. small nit — don't want to expose internal model names in header. make it variant instead: `v2-primary`, `v1-compat-shim`.

maria: check snippet:```http
X-RW-Version: v2
X-RW-Variant: v2-primary
X-RW-Fallback-Reason: quota_exceeded
X-RW-Debug-Sample: rw-202303-xyz
```

priya: perfect. question for rollout UX: should we surface a per-org banner that says "using fallback routes for X% of traffic" or keep it in telemetry only?

ryan: banner for early adopter orgs only, yes. otherwise it's noise. make it opt-in via org setting `console.show_fallback_banner=true`.

zack: add rollout guard: if fallback_rate > 5% for >10m, auto-open a ticket to infra-runbooks and a console alert.

priya: agreed. action items:
- add headers (`X-RW-Variant`, `X-RW-Fallback-Reason`, `X-RW-Debug-Sample`) in runtime (maria)
- console: aggregated fallback widget + per-org opt-in banner (ryan + console-bot)
- infra: alert when fallback_rate > 5% sustained (zack)
- telemetry: emit `compat_mismatch_count`, `fallback_rate_by_org`, sample traces (priya)

maria: I'll open the runtime PR with header patch + tests today. Will keep the header values enum-only.

ryan: I'll sketch the console UI — want a small CTA to download sample traces. :+1:

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled to staging 2309878200 for runtime header changes.

priya: thanks — once staging proves clean we'll do a soft rollout to 5 orgs tomorrow and monitor `fallback_rate_by_org` for regressions.

zack: FYI we should add a telemetry tag so we can correlate to the v2 rollout flag rollout_id=rw-v2-2026-03

priya: noted. keeping rollout_id in events. closing thread after PR links.
